description: This Java interface defines a collection of Resource objects within a policy framework, including methods for creation, retrieval, modification, removal, and JSON serialization of resources.

classes.name: Resources
classes.description: An interface representing a collection of Resource objects, supporting creation, access, modification, removal, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new Resources instance from an iterable of Resource objects or individual Resource objects.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the supported JSON schema version, which is only version 2.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Retrieves a Resource by resource type and path or by ResourceKey, returning an Optional.

methods.name: setResource
methods.description: Sets or replaces a Resource in the collection, returning a new Resources instance.

methods.name: removeResource
methods.description: Removes a Resource by resource type and path or by ResourceKey, returning a new Resources instance.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of resources contained.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the collection contains no resources.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a sequential Stream of Resource objects.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Resources to a JsonObject, including only non-hidden fields.
